decisions.reason: The quoted sentence directly states that 'grey matter volume progressively decreased over time' in 'both models' of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (CLN5 and CLN6 affected sheep). This directly supports the has_phenotype relationship between the disease and grey matter volume decrease as a clinical phenotype.

The quoted sentence directly states that 'cerebrospinal fluid volume increased in affected sheep compared with controls' in 'both models' of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis. This directly supports the has_phenotype relationship between the disease and cerebrospinal fluid volume increase as a clinical phenotype.

The quoted sentence directly states 'the caudate nucleus in CLN5 affected animals that degenerated rapidly at end-stage disease.' The grammatical subject is CLN5 affected animals (CLN5 disease patients/models), and the phenotype is caudate nucleus degeneration. This directly supports the has_phenotype relationship for CLN5 disease.
